extra.message: Pickle Deserialization RCE — Remote code execution on the server. [verified: The function course_bundle_thaw_175 at line 70 calls pickle.loads() on raw request data (request.body or GET parameter) without any validation or sanitization. The gate _wrk_gate is present but its implementation is not shown, and no input validation is evident to neutralize the untrusted data before deserialization.]

Hardcoded Default Secret Key — Attacker can forge session cookies, CSRF tokens, and other signed data, leading to account takeover and authentication bypass. [verified: The fallback SECRET_KEY 'unsafe-local-dev-key-change-me' is hardcoded and well-known; if DJANGO_SECRET_KEY is not set in environment or .env, this key is used for all cryptographic signing, enabling session forgery and account takeover.]

Credential Logging — Exposure of authorization tokens in logs, potentially leading to account compromise. [verified: The Authorization header is logged at line 88 without redaction; the _wrk_gate check only restricts access to authenticated/authorized users but does not prevent logging of sensitive credentials.]

DEBUG Mode Enabled in Production — Information disclosure of source code, stack traces, environment variables, and media files. [verified: Line 10 of settings.py defaults DEBUG to True when DJANGO_DEBUG env var is absent. In production this exposes detailed error pages, stack traces, and media files via static() in urls.py with no compensating control.]

Unauthenticated Information Disclosure — Leakage of sensitive operational details, payment flags, and contact information. [verified: course_roster_fold_036 lacks the _wrk_gate authorization check present in all other ops endpoints, returning a static memo containing 'renewal risk, payment flags, owner contact details' to any unauthenticated request.]
